summary: Completed comprehensive frontend UI testing for DMMobile Shop 2080 Future Glass Marketplace redesign. All 15 requested features verified working correctly. Dark futuristic glassmorphism theme applied successfully with dark background (#060912), glass cards, neon accents, and framer-motion animations. All 38+ homepage sections render correctly including Hero, Trust Strip, Top Selling, Hot Selling Categories, Quad Promo cards, Top Brands, Trending Products, Why Choose, Customer Reviews, Blog, Community, WhatsApp, Newsletter, and Footer. Product detail page, admin login, and mobile responsive design all working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: FuturisticHome.jsx is well-structured with modular components for each section
futuristic-2080.css properly overrides App.css styles for dark glass effects
Admin panel styles are explicitly excluded from glass effects (line 1053-1059 in CSS)
Responsive breakpoints at 1100px, 760px, 640px, and 480px handle mobile layouts correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI redesign complete and verified. All homepage sections render with dark futuristic glass theme. Product detail page has glass styling. Admin login page works and shows login form. Mobile bottom navigation (Home, Categories, AI Deals, Auction, Account) visible on mobile viewport. Category rail hidden on mobile as expected. Trust strip shows all 4 items. All brand pills render. Blog section shows 3 cards. Footer has all 5 columns.
